Community FAQ

The quick answers new Legionnaires ask.

How do I join?

Tap "Join Telegram" above for the main community, and follow @TardicoinAI on X. That's the whole Legion — welcome aboard. 🐾

Is it safe? How do I avoid scams?

Admins will NEVER DM you first. There is no presale and no "send SOL to double it." Never share your seed phrase with anyone. Only trust the official contract address pinned in our channels.

When does $TARDI launch?

Launching soon via a fair launch on Solana. Turn on notifications in the Telegram and follow X so you don't miss it.

How can I help the project?

Hold, spread the word, make memes, and (at launch) run a node. See "Ways to serve" above — every bit grows the swarm.
